name: meerlume
description: Build and run customer chat bots for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and website chat.

capabilities: Build a customer chat bot from a description of your business
Change what a bot says and asks, then publish it
Set services, staff, opening hours, closed days and special hours
Look up bots, bookings, conversations and contacts
Get a link to connect WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger or Instagram
defaultPrompt: What bookings do I have this week?
Close my shop from 24 to 26 December.
Build a bot for my barbershop that takes bookings.

positive.description: List the account's bots and their channels
positive.prompt: Which bots do I have in Meerlume, and which channels is each one on?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the bots on the reviewer account, including Bilbao Ramen Assistant (live, website chat), with each bot's channels.

positive.prompt: What bookings do I have coming up at Bilbao Ramen?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the upcoming table reservations for Bilbao Ramen Assistant, with customer name, area (Counter or Main Room), date and time.

positive.description: Close the calendar for a holiday, then reopen it
positive.prompt: Close Bilbao Ramen on 24 December, then remove that closure again.
positive.expected_behavior: Closes 24 December on the bot's calendar and confirms it, then removes the same closure and confirms the day is back to normal hours.

positive.description: Add a service to the calendar
positive.prompt: Add a service called Tasting menu to Bilbao Ramen: 90 minutes, 45 euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 90-minute service named Tasting menu priced at 45 EUR to the bot's calendar and confirms it can be booked straight away.

positive.description: Change what the bot says and publish it
positive.prompt: Make the welcome message of Bilbao Ramen Assistant friendlier, then publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Rewrites the welcome message as an unpublished change and reports what changed with a link to view it in Meerlume, then publishes the bot and confirms it is live.

negative.description: Out of scope: a request unrelated to Meerlume should not call any Meerlume tool
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Bilbao this weekend?

negative.description: The app cannot message customers: it should explain it can't send messages, without calling a tool that does
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to Mikel Arrieta saying his table is ready.

negative.description: The app cannot delete bots: it should explain that deleting is done in Meerlume, without deleting anything
negative.prompt: Delete the Bilbao Ramen Assistant bot.

review.commerce_description: Meerlume in ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of Meerlume for ChatGPT. Owners can build a customer chat bot from a description of their business, change what it says, publish it, manage services, staff, opening hours and closed days, look up bookings, conversations and contacts, and get a link to connect WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram, Stripe, Slack or Notion, which they finish in Meerlume. Sign-in is OAuth with the user's own Meerlume account; there is no API key.
